description: W Protocol label record. Extends com.atproto.label.defs#label with W Protocol label namespace.

src.description: DID of the actor who created this label. Compatible with com.atproto.label.defs#label.src.

uri.description: AT URI of the resource this label applies to. Compatible with com.atproto.label.defs#label.uri.

val.description: The short string name of the value or type of this label. Compatible with com.atproto.label.defs#label.val.

neg.description: If true, this is a negation label. Compatible with com.atproto.label.defs#label.neg.

cts.description: Timestamp when this label was created. Compatible with com.atproto.label.defs#label.cts.

label.description: etzhayyim extension: W Protocol label namespace identifier
